meta.note: HYPOTHETICAL sample feed for offline demos of Trade Watch. Not real news. Scenarios are hand-written planning estimates in the same format the AI returns.

items.title: HYPOTHETICAL: China extends anti-dumping duties on Canadian canola seed for another year

affected.reasoning: An extension keeps a major export market restricted, holding farm-gate canola prices down.
Minor spill-over pressure as oilseed acres shift.

assumptions: No new export markets absorb the displaced volume within the crop year.
The headline gives no duty rate; changes are planning estimates.

items.title: HYPOTHETICAL: India removes import duty on yellow peas until March

affected.reasoning: Duty-free access to a large pulse importer would raise demand for Canadian peas.
Pulse demand may firm more broadly.

assumptions: The window is short; benefit depends on timing of sales.
No duty rate is stated in the headline; changes are planning estimates.

items.title: HYPOTHETICAL: United States announces tariff on Canadian oats from next spring

affected.reasoning: The US is the main destination for Canadian oats; a tariff would cut demand.

assumptions: Tariff takes effect as announced and is not offset by a quick deal.
